sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Arubendra Singh Parihar - Advocate for the applicant  Shri Pankaj Raj Ahirwar - P.L. appearing on behalf of res  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 06.12.2024 in connection with Crime No. 398/2024 registered at P.S.- Nagod District Satna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 & 376 (2)(n)
of IPC and under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that the applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative assault on the minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant after referring to prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, submits that it is a consensual relationship.
Prosecutrix herself had forced applicant to take her, and only thereafter applicant took away prosecutrix.
It is also urged that parties have solemnized marriage.
Applicant is in jail since 06.12.2024.
Applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is aged 16 years.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:5809 2 MCRC-4982-2025 Pawan Basor vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51322261/
1 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently
, this bail application stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to appellant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE sm Pawan Basor vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51322261/
